questions.q: Is annotation compulsory in Cambridge IGCSE Art & Design?
options: No, but if used it must be relevant, purposeful and in English
No, and it is not allowed
questions.why: The syllabus says candidates do not have to annotate; if they do it must be relevant, purposeful and in English.

questions.q: In 'content, form, process, mood', what does 'form' cover?
options: How the work is put together using the formal elements and composition
questions.why: Form is line, tone, colour, shape, composition and so on.

questions.q: Which sentence is the strongest annotation?
options: I used 4B pencil to show creases; the dark tone makes the shoe feel heavy, matching my theme of journeys.
First I drew, then I shaded.
questions.why: It names media, a visual effect and a link to the theme.

questions.q: Describe the mood of an artwork you know and explain two ways it is created.
questions.model: In The Scream the mood is anxious. The wavy lines of the sky make everything seem unstable and the orange against dark blue creates tension.
points: names an artwork and a mood
